entries.cf8a971e04c0fb58: The company is headquartered in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo, and is a comprehensive energy service company (ESCO) that forms a group with seven consolidated subsidiaries and four non-consolidated subsidiaries. It mainly operates a green energy business and also runs an electricity retail business and an energy-saving support service business; revenue in the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥20,737 million, and consolidated employees numbered 297. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market.
entries.e2c6230e03c42d7d: This business develops, builds and operates power plants that use domestically sourced woody biomass as fuel; revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥13,125 million, making it the largest business. Five power plants are in operation, namely EF-ON Hita, EF-ON Shirakawa, EF-ON Bungoono, EF-ON Miyu and EF-ON Shingu, and the electricity generated is mainly sold to power companies' transmission and distribution operators. Operation of the power plants and fuel supply are handled by EF-BIOS Co., Ltd., and this business also includes the forestry business, which covers afforestation, forest cultivation and timber material production.
